offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures recreational powerboats, including performance sport boats for water skiing and wakeboarding, and sterndrive and outboard boats. Sells mainly to consumers through a network of independent dealers.

primary_products.value: performance sport boats; outboard family boats; sterndrive boats; boat trailers and parts

customer_segment.value: B2C: recreational boaters and boating enthusiasts buying through dealers; B2B: independent boat dealers purchasing inventory

revenue_model.value: product sales: new boats, trailers, options and parts sold to dealers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds boats from purchased engines, components and materials, sold to dealers

geography_served.value: global: Mainly United States and Canada, with dealers in Europe, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Brands in performance sport, outboard and sterndrive boats sharing dealers and technology

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent authorized boat dealers in North America and internationally

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Boat safety and emissions rules from US Coast Guard and EPA, CARB, engine and environmental regulations

notes: Brand set (MasterCraft, Crest, Balise, NauticStar) recalled from memory; may have changed.
